evals.name: rerender-000-from-existing-captures
evals.prompt: Re-render the 60 second walkthrough of example 000 with the act 4 scorecard line about artifact checksums reworded so it is true for a trace run. Don't film anything new.
evals.expected_output: Composition edited in docs/video/<slug>/, no capture re-run, clips reused, snapshot of act 4 read, render in the background, report states the narration was not listened to.
assertions: No hfw capture command was run
The new scorecard text does not claim artifact or checksum comparison
hfw snapshot was run at a time inside act 4 (45-55 s) and the PNG was read
Nothing under .cache/ or any .mp4 was committed

evals.name: new-example-walkthrough-needs-approval
evals.prompt: Make the 60 second walkthrough video for example 105 with live Jenkins and GitHub Actions footage.
evals.expected_output: Facts gathered from examples/105, project initialised from the reference, narration and on-screen claims shown for approval, Jenkins filmed (own-job mode if the twin finishes, else harness mode), and an explicit approval request before hfw capture gha.
assertions: source-facts.md lists the example's real job count and complexity score with their source files
The agent asked for approval before running hfw capture gha
Every sped-up stretch in the final composition has a visible speed label

evals.name: publish-dry-run-first
evals.prompt: Put the rendered walkthrough on GitHub releases so I can share it.
evals.expected_output: hfw publish dry run shown (repo visibility, tag, asset, sha256), then the real upload only after the user confirms; the published URL and record file reported.
assertions: The first publish call had no --yes
The report mentions whether the repository (and so the asset) is private
The video file itself was not committed to git
